name: The Golden Mare
storyline:
The ouroboros killer has challenged you openly to find him or else he keeps his kill streak. Kill not only challenges you but also mocks the police department. Find him before anyone else is killed.

Look for the hospital records, browse through news articles, and analyze. The Evidence Board can be a great help to organize your findings and make connections between various clues while you move through the loop of cases. With every new clue you find, you’ll get closer to understanding the underlying issue.
Investigate the issue, explore through the loop, and try to connect the dots to solve the mystery. The truth is out there. If you can find it you breakthrough the loop or you may end up getting pulled in deeper.

Piece together the truth. Expose the killer. Survive the shift.

Because at Redmarsh hospital... the most dangerous thing isn’t the disease. It’s the silence.
summary: The ouroboros killer has challenged you openly to find him or else he keeps his kill streak. Kill not only challenges you but also mocks the police department. Find him before anyone else is killed.
